chapter: Dance halls and learning jazz in Japan
title: Hearing Teddy Wilson's Sweet Lorraine
summary: A jazz record collector played her Teddy Wilson, her first jazz inspiration.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: collector. And somehow he thought I had potentiality. So he invited me over to his home and played a traditional record. It’s a kind of famous story. And he played the Teddy Wilson, “Sweet Lorraine.” And I thought I wanted to play just like that. That’s my first introduction. It was in 1947 I believe.
So you went from wanting to play just like Mozart, to just like Teddy Wilson. That’s good company. You could do a lot worse.
